dog.description_text: Say hello to Leelah, a sweet and soulful pup who’s ready to find her forever home! This sweet girl originally travelled to ARF from Georgia and was adopted earlier this year, unfortunately returning recently to no fault of her own. At 4 years old, Leelah has outgrown the puppy phase but still has plenty of playful energy and love to give. With a little patience and consistency, Leelah is sure to spread her contagious smile and thrive in a loving home!
